Pieter Levels dominated by volume with his AI-spam block list: agents now file appeals to get off it (115k), it costs him about $600/day (70k), and he plans to send his detection algorithm to X (41k). Ethan Mollick's read on a new Anthropic paper (151k, 2.1k bookmarks) framed the human side: the value comes from reorganizing work, and big firms are fighting over tiny AI teams. The meta: agents are now on both sides of every form, platforms are bundling into plugin stores, and the edge is a small team or solo builder with a sharp niche.
